{'text': '在對 Apple 創下高達 57 億美元專利侵權裁決的歷史性判決之後，Taction Technology 目前正就未來 iPhone 及 Apple Watch 銷售尋求額外賠償、利息以及持續專利使用費。以下是詳情。', 'paragraph_context': 'Following a historic $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict against Apple, Taction Technology is now seeking additional damages, interest, and ongoing royalties on future iPhone and Apple Watch sales. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'Taction 尋求額外賠償', 'paragraph_context': 'Taction seeks additional compensation'}

{'text': '上月底，一個美國陪審團裁定 Apple 的 Taptic Engine 侵犯了 Taction Technology 持有的兩項專利，判予 57 億美元賠償。Apple 強烈反對這項裁決，辯稱其技術與 Taction 的技術在本質上有重大差異，並表示會提出上訴。', 'paragraph_context': 'Late last month, a US jury found that Apple’s Taptic Engine infringed on two patents held by Taction Technology, awarding $5.7 billion in damages. Apple strongly disputed the verdict, arguing that its technology was fundamentally different from Taction’s, and said it would appeal.'}

{'text': '數週後，Apple 要求法庭推翻裁決或下令重審，理由是 Taction 未能就 57 億美元的賠償金額提供足夠證據，令陪審團只能進行「大規模的不當猜測」。', 'paragraph_context': 'A few weeks later, Apple asked the court to overturn the verdict or order a new trial, arguing that Taction had failed to provide evidence supporting the $5.7 billion award, leaving jurors to engage in “impermissible guesswork on a massive scale.”'}

{'text': '據路透社報導，Taction 近日已提交動議，要求追加賠償、未來 iPhone 及 Apple Watch 銷售的持續專利使用費，以及追溯至 2021 年 4 月的判決前利息，再加上自最終判決日起至 Apple 實際付款期間的額外利息。', 'paragraph_context': 'Now, as spotted by Reuters, Taction has filed a motion seeking supplemental damages, ongoing royalties on future iPhone and Apple Watch sales, prejudgment interest dating back to April 2021, and additional interest from the date of the final judgment until Apple pays.'}

{'text': 'Taction 表示，陪審團判給的賠償只涵蓋了 Apple 截至 2026 年 3 月的銷售額，當中尚有六個月的 iPhone 及 Apple Watch 銷售未獲賠償，因此公司現就此提出追討。', 'paragraph_context': 'According to Taction, the jury’s award only accounted for Apple’s sales through March 2026, leaving another six months of iPhone and Apple Watch sales for which the company is now seeking compensation.'}

{'text': '有趣的是，Taction 正引用 Apple 早前對 Samsung 專利訴訟中的自家論點，來支持其對持續專利使用費的要求。', 'paragraph_context': 'Interestingly, Taction is using Apple’s own arguments from its previous patent litigation against Samsung to support its request for ongoing royalties.'}

{'text': '在該案中，Apple 曾主張專利使用費不僅應適用於被判侵權的產品，還應涵蓋採用基本相同技術的新型號產品。', 'paragraph_context': 'In that case, Apple argued that royalties should apply not only to products found to infringe its patents, but also to newer models using essentially the same technology.'}

{'text': 'Taction 如今提出相同的論點，要求將專利使用費支付範圍延伸至 Apple 最新產品，包括 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、Apple Watch Series 12 及 Apple Watch Ultra 4，並聲稱這些產品「與侵權產品相比僅是表面上的差異」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Taction is now making the same argument, seeking to extend royalty payments to Apple’s latest devices, including the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12, and Apple Watch Ultra 4, which it says “are not more than colorably different from the infringing products.”'}

{'text': '最高留言由 GoldPlanet 發布', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by GoldPlanet'}

{'text': 'Taction？聽起來像是胡塞武裝的分裂派系。祝他們雙線作戰好運。第一，從 Apple 手中撬走 57 億美元而不打一場曠日持久的法律戰。第二，每賣一部 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 都分一杯羹。真的嗎？到底誰在替他們出主意，仙女教母嗎？Bibbidi-bobbidi-幾十億。', 'paragraph_context': "Taction? Sounds like a breakaway faction of the Houthis. Good luck to them on two fronts. One: prising $5.7 billion out of Apple without a legal war lasting until kingdom come. Two: a cut of every iPhone and Apple Watch sold. Really? Who's advising these people, the fairy godmother? Bibbidi-bobbidi-billions."}

{'text': '引自法庭文件：', 'paragraph_context': 'From the filing:'}

{'text': 'Apple 本身已接納此規則。作為尋求持續專利使用費的專利權人，Apple 曾向北加州聯邦地區法院表示：「任何持續專利使用費不僅涵蓋陪審團認定侵權產品的持續銷售，還涵蓋與該等產品『並非僅有表面差異』的其他產品。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple itself has embraced this rule. As a patentee seeking ongoing royalties, Apple told the Northern District of California that “any ongoing royalties extend not only to ongoing sales of products found to infringe by the jury, but also to products ‘not more than colorably different’ therefrom.”'}

{'text': '就 Taction 所聲稱侵權產品的持續付款事宜，該公司請求法庭強制 Apple 提供其美國銷售的季度報告，並須於每季結束後 30 日內繳付專利使用費。', 'paragraph_context': 'For the ongoing payments on what Taction claims are infringing products, the company is asking the court to compel Apple to provide quarterly reports of its US sales, with royalty payments due within 30 days of the end of each quarter.'}

{'text': 'Taction 根據加州法律，建議判決前利息以年利率 7% 計算。該公司亦請求法庭將專利使用費支付期延長至 2035 年 9 月 24 日，即相關專利屆滿到期之日。', 'paragraph_context': 'Taction is proposing a 7% annual rate for prejudgment interest under California law. The company is also asking the court to extend royalty payments through September 24, 2035, when the patents in question are set to expire.'}

{'text': '有一點必須留意：法官尚未將陪審團裁決正式登錄為最終判決，因此原本 57 億美元的賠償及 Taction 的額外要求仍未解決，Apple 推翻裁決或要求重審的動議亦然。', 'paragraph_context': 'One important caveat to keep in mind: the judge has yet to enter the jury’s verdict as a final judgment, so the original $5.7 billion award and Taction’s additional demands remain unresolved, as does Apple’s motion to overturn the verdict or secure a new trial.'}
